description: Allocate copies of a holding (holding_id from search_collection/where_is) to a deck (id or name). shared:false (default) claims free copies exclusively — the sum of non-shared allocations can never exceed the stack size. shared:true deliberately shares copies that other decks also use (always disclose: which decks, where the card physically is). status "staged" (default) earmarks without moving; "sleeved" also physically moves the cards into the deck's location (splitting the stack when only part of it is sleeved).
name: allocate
title: Allocate
